subject: small chest
text: Defeating the wolf enemy in the green emblem room reveals a small chest containing a Blue Rupee.

evidence.quote: Defeat the wolf enemy in this room and open the small chest to acquire a BLUE RUPEE.

subject: green emblem room torches
text: Shooting a Fire Arrow at the torch above the door and using Din's Fire to light the other four torches unlocks the door.

evidence.quote: Shoot a Fire Arrow at the torch above the door and then use Din's Fire to light the other four torches around you. Head through the door that opens up.

subject: chest
text: A chest on the left side at the start of the purple emblem room contains a Blue Rupee.

evidence.quote: At the beginning of this room you will see a chest on your left containing a BLUE RUPEE, you can Longshot to get over there if you wish.

subject: treasure chest
text: Standing on the button on the ice platform spawns a treasure chest containing the Golden Gauntlets.

evidence.quote: Stand on the button to spawn a treasure chest then turn around and Longshot to it. The chest contains GOLDEN GAUNTLETS, an upgrade to the Silver Gauntlets which allow you to lift very heavy objects with your bare hands.

subject: Great Fairy Fountain
text: Lifting the enormous rock at the end of the path left of the rainbow bridge reveals a Great Fairy who outlines hearts in white to double Link's health total.

evidence.quote: Leave the castle and make a left at the bottom of the rainbow bridge, follow this path to the end and lift up that enormous rock to reveal another Great Fairy Fountain. She will outline all of your hearts in white which doubles you health total, it will now take twice as many hits to kill you than before, one of the most helpful upgrades in the game.

subject: chest
text: In the blue circle room, the chest on the right contains a Recovery Heart, while the chest on the left freezes Link.

evidence.quote: Next, open the chest on the right to get a RECOVERY HEART but not the one on the left as it will just freeze you.

subject: blue circle room block puzzle
text: Under a two-minute limit, push the far block right and down into the hole, then push the other block right, up, and left to climb it, melt the red ice, and hammer the rusted button.

evidence.quote: You've got two minutes to do the following, grab hold of the block further away from you and push it to the right, and then down so it falls into the hole....After that push the other block right, up and then left. Climb on top of it and melt the red ice up here, use the Megaton Hammer to pound down the rusted button and then go through the door at the top.

subject: chest
text: After defeating the fiery slugs and hitting the crystal through the gate, open the chest to obtain Bombchus.

evidence.quote: In the next room defeat the fiery slugs and then hit the crystal through the gate with your sword. Open the chest which contains Bombchus and equip them.

subject: orange circle room gate
text: Throwing a Bombchu through the hole at the top of the gate hits the crystal on the other side and unlocks the gate.

evidence.quote: Now look up at the top of the gate to see a hole, throw a Bombchu through there and it will hit the crystal on the other side, unlocking the gate.

subject: orange circle final room sun emblem
text: Shooting a Fire Arrow at the ceiling web allows Link to stand in the light beam and reflect light with the Mirror Shield at the correct sun emblem, while wrong emblems summon a hand.

evidence.quote: In the final room, equip a Fire Arrow and aim it up at the ceiling, shoot the web and then stand in the beam and reflect the light with your Mirror Shield to reflect light at the correct sun emblem. If you hit one of the wrong ones, be ready to move and avoid the hand that comes down to grab you.

subject: chest
text: Eliminating the Skulltula and three bats in the yellow room allows Link to open the center chest for a Small Key.

evidence.quote: there is a Skulltula as well as three bats to eliminate in this room. Once you've done so, open the chest in the middle of the room to get a SMALL KEY.

subject: Triforce symbol chest
text: Playing Zelda's Lullaby while standing on the Triforce symbol drops a chest with a Small Key and opens the door.

evidence.quote: Stand on it and play Zelda's Lullaby on your Ocarina, a chest drops with another SMALL KEY and the door opens.

subject: coloured chest
text: Defeating the two Stalfos in the tower structure allows Link to open the coloured chest containing the Boss Key.

evidence.quote: Defeat them and open the coloured chest to acquire the BOSS KEY.

subject: Ganondorf
text: Deflect Ganondorf's energy blasts with a sword until one strikes him, stun him with a Light Arrow, and slash him on the center platform with the Biggoron's Sword across three knockdowns.

evidence.quote: Ganondorf will fire an energy blast at you, deflect it with your sword and he'll deflect it back. Keep doing this over and over again until eventually it hits him. At this point you have a very short window of time to bring up a Light Arrow and fire it at him. When he goes down either roll across to the middle platform with the Hover Boots equipped, or Longshot to Ganondorf himself and slash with the Biggoron's Sword....Doing this it will only take a mere three knock downs to actually take him out, but the battle isn't over yet.

subject: Ganon
text: Link can roll under Ganon's legs to slash his tail with the Biggoron's Sword or Megaton Hammer, or stun his face with a Light Arrow to get behind him.

evidence.quote: The tactic to use here is relatively simple, with whatever weapon you are using, roll under Ganon's legs and slash like crazy at his tail. Roll out of the way to avoid his sword swings and repeat this pattern over and over again....The alternative to this is targeting his face with the L/Z button and firing a Light Arrow to stun him, then simply running around behind and doing the same thing.

subject: Ganon
text: The final blow against Ganon must be delivered with a swing of the Master Sword, as no other weapon will suffice.

evidence.quote: The battle can only be won with a swing of the Master Sword, no other weapon will suffice. Strike the final blow and...

subject: Shooting Gallery
text: Playing the Shooting Gallery in Hyrule Market costs 20 Rupees, granting fifteen shots to hit ten Rupees.

evidence.quote: What you have to do in the Shooting Gallery is pay 20 Rupees in order to begin the game. You are given fifteen shots and you have to shoot down ten Rupees.

subject: Shooting Gallery
text: Hitting eight out of ten targets awards a free game, while hitting all ten targets rewards Link with a Bullet Bag that increases Deku Seed capacity from 30 to 40.

evidence.quote: If you manage to hit eight out of the ten targets then you will be rewarded with a free game, if you manage to hit ten out of the ten targets then you will be rewarded with a BULLET BAG for your Deku Seeds, this allows you to carry 40 Deku Seeds for use with your Fairy Slingshot instead of 30, and is quite a helpful item.

subject: Shooting Gallery
text: If you can manage to hit all ten then you will be rewarded with the BIG QUIVER, which allows you to carry a total of 40 Arrows instead of 30.

evidence.quote: If you can manage to hit all ten then you will be rewarded with the BIG QUIVER, a special item which allows you to carry a total of 40 Arrows instead of 30.
